title: File:Silicon solar cell (PERC) front and back.jpg
desc: Modern crystalline silicon solar cell. The PERC design (passivated emitter and rear cell) has finger-shaped contacts at the rear side, visible as lines (right image). Cell efficiencies presently exceed 20%. Fabricated at the Institute for Solar Energy Research Hamelin (ISFH), Germany.

title: File:Bifacial PERC cell.tif
desc: Front (a) and back (b) sides of a bifacial PERC solar cell. In this design, the higher semiconductor sheet resistance at the back forces using a higher density of fingers in the metal.
